breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 2D simulation requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty'. It explicitly stated, 'The front and back patches are treated as empty to enforce a 2D simulation,' and then correctly applied the 'empty' boundary condition to all relevant fields (k, epsilon, nut, alphat, U, T, p, p_rgh), fixing the user's error of using a wall condition.
